notes.title: Collect Call is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
[b]I just got the email this afternoon, Valve has finished testing Collect Call's compatibility for the Steam Deck![/b]

From the beginning, Collect Call was intended for the Deck, so I'm glad it's finally verified.

They did leave a note though, it seems the game does not automatically switch to a different controller once you start playing. I plan on releasing a small patch later this week to fix it.

notes.title: 1.2 Game is now more playable.
notes.notes: Fixed a ton of stuff, including a few crashes. Please report any issues to the Discord server.

notes.title: Little changes add up
notes.notes:
Lots of small bugs have been reported to me in the month since release, I've fixed lots of them here.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a save file made on the last level will never finish loading.
[*] Improvements to joystick use in menus
[*] Simplified UI code
[/list]
I'm also planning on changing the last level somewhat to make it less ambiguous. That update will come along later.
